73: def toStress (Q : MaxwellQuadraticForm C) : StressTensorDataLocalV32 (lightNet C) (lightBoost C) where
74:   T := extendByZero Q
75:   T_vac := fun x => by
76:     show extendByZero Q C.Ω x = 0
77:     rw [extendByZero_on_dom Q Q.Dom_vac, Q.Q_vac]
78:   T_covariant := fun a ψ x => by
79:     show extendByZero Q (C.Γ (U1 a) ψ) x = extendByZero Q ψ (x - a)
80:     by_cases h : ψ ∈ Q.Dom
81:     · rw [extendByZero_on_dom Q ((Q.Dom_translate a ψ).mpr h), extendByZero_on_dom Q h, Q.Q_covariant a ψ x h]
82:     · have h' : C.Γ (U1 a) ψ ∉ Q.Dom := fun hm => h ((Q.Dom_translate a ψ).mp hm)
83:       rw [extendByZero_off_dom Q h', extendByZero_off_dom Q h]
84:   symmetric := fun ψ x => by
85:     by_cases h : ψ ∈ Q.Dom
86:     · rw [extendByZero_on_dom Q h]; exact Q.Q_symmetric ψ x h
87:     · rw [extendByZero_off_dom Q h]; exact Matrix.transpose_zero
88:   test_integrable := fun ψ ν μ f hf hc => by
89:     by_cases h : ψ ∈ Q.Dom
90:     · simp only [extendByZero_on_dom Q h]; exact Q.Q_test_integrable ψ h ν μ f hf hc
91:     · simp only [extendByZero_off_dom Q h, Matrix.zero_apply, mul_zero, zero_mul]
92:       exact integrable_zero _ _ _
93:   conserved := fun ψ ν f hf hc => by
94:     by_cases h : ψ ∈ Q.Dom
95:     · simp only [extendByZero_on_dom Q h]; exact Q.Q_conserved ψ h ν f hf hc
96:     · simp only [extendByZero_off_dom Q h, Matrix.zero_apply, mul_zero, zero_mul, integral_zero,
97:         Finset.sum_const_zero]
98:   boost_covariant := fun s ψ x => by
99:     show extendByZero Q (C.Γ (B0 s) ψ) x =
100:       (TGLExt.boostMat (-s)).transpose * extendByZero Q ψ (wedgeBoostMap (-s) x) * TGLExt.boostMat (-s)
101:     by_cases h : ψ ∈ Q.Dom
102:     · rw [extendByZero_on_dom Q ((Q.Dom_boost s ψ).mpr h), extendByZero_on_dom Q h, Q.Q_boost_covariant s ψ x h]
103:     · have h' : C.Γ (B0 s) ψ ∉ Q.Dom := fun hm => h ((Q.Dom_boost s ψ).mp hm)
104:       rw [extendByZero_off_dom Q h', extendByZero_off_dom Q h, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]

9: theorem modularEnergy_of_boostEnergy (C : ContratoH2 W R N) {ψ : W.H} {b : ℝ}
10:     (h : HasBoostEnergy C.boost.V ψ b) : HasModularEnergy C.Δit ψ (2 * Real.pi * b) := by
11:   unfold HasBoostEnergy at h
12:   unfold HasModularEnergy
13:   have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -(2 * Real.pi * t)) (-(2 * Real.pi)) 0 := by
14:     have h0 := (hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).const_mul (-(2 * Real.pi))
15:     have e : (fun t : ℝ => -(2 * Real.pi * t)) = (fun y : ℝ => -(2 * Real.pi) * id y) := by
16:       funext t; simp [id]
17:     rw [e]
18:     exact h0.congr_deriv (by ring)
19:   have h' : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪ψ, C.boost.V s ψ⟫_ℂ) (I * (b : ℂ)) (-(2 * Real.pi * 0)) := by
20:     simpa using h
21:   have hc := h'.scomp (0:ℝ) hg
22:   have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => ⟪ψ, C.Δit t ψ⟫_ℂ)
23:       = (fun s : ℝ => ⟪ψ, C.boost.V s ψ⟫_ℂ) ∘ (fun t : ℝ => -(2 * Real.pi * t)) := by
24:     funext t
25:     simp only [Function.comp, C.bw]
26:   rw [hfun]
27:   refine hc.congr_deriv ?_
28:   rw [Complex.real_smul]
29:   push_cast
30:   ring
31: 
32: theorem modularEnergy_unique {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
33:     {D : ℝ → (H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H)} {ψ : H} {k k' : ℝ}
34:     (h : HasModularEnergy D ψ k) (h' : HasModularEnergy D ψ k') : k = k' := by
35:   have hu := h.unique h'
36:   have hI : I * (k : ℂ) = I * (k' : ℂ) := neg_inj.mp hu
37:   have : (k : ℂ) = k' := mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero hI
38:   exact_mod_cast this
